# Orbital mechanics

Kepler's third law[^kepler] relates period and distance: $T^2 \propto a^3$.

$$
T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{a^3}{GM}}
$$

## Escape velocity
The escape velocity is $v_e = \sqrt{2GM/r}$[^escape].

## Hohmann transfer $\Delta v$
- First burn: $\Delta v_1 = \sqrt{\mu/r_1}\left(\sqrt{2r_2/(r_1+r_2)} - 1\right)$
- Second burn
  $$
  \Delta v_2 = \sqrt{\mu/r_2}\left(1 - \sqrt{2r_1/(r_1+r_2)}\right)
  $$
- Product term $a*b*c$ in a title

[^kepler]: Published in *Harmonices Mundi*, 1619.
[^escape]: Ignoring atmospheric drag.
    Indented continuation of the footnote.
